title: Iki entity type extension (iki/v1)
description: Fields this plugin adds to another plugin's entity type. They live in this plugin's own table, joined to the type's.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this manifest follows.

adds_to.description: The type to add fields to, as `plugin.Type`. It isn't a subtype: the type's records get the fields.

fields.description: The fields to add, by name.

^x-.description: A key for tools, such as `x-acme-reviewed`: kept in the file, ignored by Iki, and dropped from the build (ADR 0293).
